records.part: Odor Control Scrubber for Elden Pump Station - PeaceMaker 6x5 Dry Air Scrubber with 105 cubic feet of Converting & Polishing Media and Blower
records.reason: The District staff have reviewed other units and can't seem to find packaged units that remove odors as effectively as the PeaceMaker. Other vendors have units out-of-state or don't have units used within the South Coast Air Quality Management District.
